title: Adaptive Theory Approach in Leadership: A Guide to Educational Management System and Mechanisms
impact: 32 education leaders (HEIs, TESDA, DepEd) - small-sample, single-program, convenient sampling
ends: A guide to the educational management system & mechanisms
Handle change; spur teacher innovation; raise accountability
Better problem-solving & decision-making for quality of education
Finding: significant correlation (adaptive leadership and management)

verbatims.text: The study aims to examine the process of adaptive theory in leadership as a guide to educational management mechanisms...
Quantitative research design is employed in the study. It adopts the pedagogical immersive method in education...
The study comprised thirty-two (32) respondents only.
Findings show that there is a significant correlation on the process of adaptive theory in leadership as a guide to educational management mechanisms...
The respondents... are the educational leaders in the various educational institutions like the HEIs, TESDA, and DepEd...
